image_description: Two compact audio cassettes placed side-by-side on a white surface. The left cassette has a colorful abstract label with pink and orange gradients; the right cassette features a 'K7' logo and 'Famous Music' text with blue and yellow graphics. Both have transparent plastic shells revealing internal spools and tape mechanisms.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'K7' and surrounding smaller text appear slightly distorted and irregular, typical of AI-generated text rendering issues, though largely legible.
The text 'Compact Cassette' appears somewhat soft and lacks the crisp edge definition expected from printed paper labels, suggesting slight generative blur.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific subclass of audio cassette and distinguish from similar rectangular media cases.
To rigorously audit the legibility and correctness of the text on the labels, which showed minor signs of distortion.
To verify the physical separation between the two cassettes and ensure the transparent casing has correct depth properties relative to the internal spools.
To check for any fusion artifacts between the cassettes or bleeding into the background, especially along the transparent edges.

focus_areas: Transparency and refraction of plastic casing
Edge sharpness between cassettes and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text rendering on the labels. AI models often struggle with small, curved, or stylized text on product packaging. Verify if the 'K7' logo and other text are structurally sound or if they exhibit melting/gibberish characteristics. Also, ensure the transparent plastic effect is physically consistent (reflections/refractions) and not just a flat overlay.
